figs.name: mutual-inductance-lcr-meter-measurement-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to measure mutual inductance and coupling coefficient using series aiding and opposing readings
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the LCR meter method: 30 mH aiding and 14 mH opposing give M = 4 mH, L1 = L2 = 11 mH and k = 0.364.
figs.after_h2: Second Example: Measuring M With an LCR Meter
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 540" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to measure mutual inductance and coupling coefficient with an LCR meter</title>
<rect width="800" height="540" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#166534" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Measuring M With an LCR Meter</text>
<rect x="30" y="65" width="340" height="70" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="200.0" y="94.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Series reading 1</text>
<text x="200.0" y="117.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">L = 30 mH</text>
<line x1="200" y1="135" x2="200" y2="163" stroke="#166534" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="30" y="165" width="340" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="200.0" y="194.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Reverse one coil</text>
<text x="200.0" y="217.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">swap its two leads</text>
<line x1="200" y1="235" x2="200" y2="263" stroke="#166534" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="30" y="265" width="340" height="70" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="200.0" y="294.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Series reading 2</text>
<text x="200.0" y="317.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">L = 14 mH</text>
<line x1="200" y1="335" x2="200" y2="363" stroke="#166534" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="30" y="365" width="340" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="200.0" y="394.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Larger reading is aiding</text>
<text x="200.0" y="417.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">L aiding 30, L opposing 14</text>
<polyline points="370,400 400,400 400,100 428,100" fill="none" stroke="#166534" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="430" y="65" width="350" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="605.0" y="94.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Mutual inductance M</text>
<text x="605.0" y="117.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">(30 minus 14) ÷ 4 = 4 mH</text>
<rect x="430" y="165" width="350" height="90" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="605.0" y="192.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Self inductances</text>
<text x="605.0" y="215.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">L1 + L2 = (30 + 14) ÷ 2 = 22 mH</text>
<text x="605.0" y="238.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">L1 = L2 = 11 mH if identical</text>
<rect x="430" y="285" width="350" height="70" rx="10" fill="#16a34a" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="605.0" y="314.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Coupling coefficient</text>
<text x="605.0" y="337.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">k = 4 ÷ √(11 × 11) = 0.364</text>
<line x1="605" y1="135" x2="605" y2="163" stroke="#166534" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="605" y1="255" x2="605" y2="283" stroke="#166534" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="400" y="470" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">The larger reading also shows where the dots are.</text>
<text x="400" y="502" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Measure at a frequency close to the real operating frequency.</text>
</svg>

figs.name: mutual-inductance-worked-example-infographic
figs.alt: mutual inductance worked example 4 mH and 9 mH coils with k 0.5 giving 3 mH
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the worked example: 4 mH and 9 mH coils with k = 0.5 give M = 3 mH, v2 = 6 V, 19 mH aiding and 7 mH opposing.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Mutual inductance worked example with M, induced voltage and series totals</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#166534" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Mutual Inductance Worked Example</text>
<text x="400" y="78" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Given: L1 = 4 mH, L2 = 9 mH, k = 0.5</text>
<rect x="25" y="100" width="360" height="190" rx="14" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="205" y="142" font-size="19" fill="#166534" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">M = k × √(L1 × L2)</text>
<text x="205" y="188" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0.5 × √36 = 0.5 × 6</text>
<text x="205" y="248" font-size="30" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">M = 3 mH</text>
<rect x="415" y="100" width="360" height="190" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="595" y="142" font-size="19" fill="#166534" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">v2 = M × di1 ÷ dt</text>
<text x="595" y="188" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">2 A in 1 ms: 0.003 × 2000</text>
<text x="595" y="248" font-size="30" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">v2 = 6 V</text>
<rect x="25" y="310" width="360" height="190" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="205" y="352" font-size="19" fill="#166534" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">L aiding = L1 + L2 + 2M</text>
<text x="205" y="398" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">4 + 9 + 6</text>
<text x="205" y="458" font-size="30" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">19 mH</text>
<rect x="415" y="310" width="360" height="190" rx="14" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="595" y="352" font-size="19" fill="#166534" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">L opposing = L1 + L2 minus 2M</text>
<text x="595" y="398" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">4 + 9 minus 6</text>
<text x="595" y="458" font-size="30" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">7 mH</text>
<text x="400" y="540" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">With k = 1, M = 6 mH and L opposing falls to 1 mH, the minimum</text>
</svg>
